info.title: Satelink Trading Agent API
info.description: Internal, versioned API under /v1/trading. Every route is behind TRADING_AGENT (off ⇒ 404); MCP additionally behind MCP_TRADING. Mutations need Idempotency-Key; sign/approve/release need step-up. Not mounted in app_factory while B-03/B-06/B-10 are open.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Same key + same request ⇒ replay (Idempotent-Replayed: true); different request ⇒ 422. Scoped to the principal, 24 h.
